latest_api_release.body:
## Android
- When no RetroAchievements login can be imported from an emulator, starting the proxy now offers **Log in now** or **Start without**. Logging in lets caching start right away; starting without works as before and picks up the login from your emulator's first online login. If RetroAchievements rejects the saved login, the app asks you to log in again. (#204, #210)
- Fixed an out-of-memory crash with thousands of cached games. (50ce0d8)
- **ARMSX1**: PS1 games are now picked up by Smart Cache. (#202)

## Linux (all platforms)
- Fixed crashes and very slow menus with large game libraries. On devices with little memory, like the Miyoo Mini, a few hundred cached games could make game launches, unlocks and the Cached Games menu fail or take 10+ seconds. With 1000 cached games they now take under a second. The first start after the update indexes your cache once, which can take up to a minute. (#209)
